messages:
incident-bot: PAGE mariner-prod-vpc — high 99th pct latency and increased 500s across the mariner tenant. triggered paging for oncall. incident=INC-9853
oncall-alex: oncall here. acknowledging. looking at dashboard now (ap-south-1).
sre-jordan: seeing sustained request queue growth on pool-d-3, KV cache evictions spiking. a few GPUs at 100% memory but not OOM.
eng-runtime-leah: jumping in — any recent rollouts to mariner pool?
oncall-alex: no rollout from our side in last 6h. deploy-bot shows no jobs to mariner pool.
ops-deploy-bot: deploy log: no active deployments to mariner-prod in last 24h.
account-maya: @cs-ryan flagged that Mariner CSM is on line and customers are seeing timeouts inside their app. need ETA for mitigation and a short customer note.
cs-ryan: already on call with their ops lead. they report intermittent 502s and long tail latency for generation endpoints. they asked if it's a tenant isolation problem.
eng-runtime-leah: can we isolate traffic to backup pool? suggested plan: shift mariner prefix to mariner-pool-standby. routing changes take ~30s once rule applied. need approval to failover.
sre-jordan: agree. we should also enable prefix-level KV cache flush for mariner before reroute, in case stale KV entries causing cache thrash. command to run: ```redwoodctl route update --tenant mariner --dest mariner-pool-standby --drain 30```
oncall-alex: running the KV flush now: ```redwoodctl cache flush --tenant mariner --scope kv-prefix && sleep 3 && redwoodctl route update --tenant mariner --dest mariner-pool-standby --drain 30```
eng-runtime-leah: started the route change, watching trees.
eng-runtime-leah: route applied. mariner traffic at ~70% on standby. latency dropping on p99 from 3.2s -> 0.7s for new requests.
sre-jordan: error rate down to baseline. continuing to monitor for 15m before marking mitigated.
security-nina: any evidence of noisy neighbor or cross-tenant breach? initial metrics point to resource exhaustion, not auth anomalies. will continue to monitor logs for anomalous RPCs.
product-omar: quick note — Mariner uses a long-context workload with heavy KV usage. could be cache pressure from a sudden test job?
eng-runtime-leah: found a scheduled maintenance job that restarted a subset of mariner backend workers 12m before pager. it didn't show as a deployment but triggered a config reload that caused cache eviction storms. suspect: rolling job + simultaneous long-context requests -> cache churn and queue pileup.
oncall-alex: good catch. will halt schedule and patch job to stagger restarts.
account-maya: CS update to customer drafted below — please comment before I send: "We observed elevated latency and intermittent errors affecting your Mariner environment due to an internal orchestration job. We failed over your traffic to a standby pool and are monitoring recovery. We will follow up with a detailed RCA and any credits as needed."
cs-ryan: tweak: mention expected next update in 60m and point to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9853.
sre-jordan: mitigation complete — holding 20m watch. marking incident state: mitigated (routing fallback applied). recommend RCA owner = eng-runtime-leah.
eng-runtime-leah: taking RCA. timeline and repro steps I will own. assigning follow-ups: patch restart job to stagger (eng-runtime), add guard to block heavy KV eviction during restarts (infra), and add a routing automatic fallback for tenant isolation (platform).
product-omar: for customer comms add: "We are offering one week of service credit and a formal RCA within 72 hours." get OK from finance/sales.
account-maya: will coordinate credit authorization; if RCA confirms internal orchestration caused impact, we can propose 7 days credit.
security-nina: no indicators of compromise, this is operational. will sign off on customer statement once RCA draft is posted.
sre-jordan: logging final notes: postmortem plan: 1) timeline & root cause, 2) mitigations applied, 3) permanent fixes and rollout plan, 4) customer impact and credit proposal, 5) QA/test/process changes.
eng-runtime-leah: creating RCA doc and will post link in this thread within 24h. assign follow-up meeting with Mariner technical contact + exec briefing for Monday.
cs-ryan: customer notified with interim note (60m update). they requested rollback details and an exec contact. Maya to provide exec briefing.
account-maya: prepping exec note now, will send draft to @product-omar and @eng-runtime-leah for approval.
oncall-alex: thanks team — moving to watch, will escalate immediately if any regression.
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-9853 status changed -> MITIGATED; watch window started at 1778123720.
eng-runtime-leah: final attachment before I close: suggested permanent changes: "(a) stagger restarts; (b) KV eviction circuit breaker per-tenant; (c) automated failover policy for tenant isolation; (d) add synthetic traffic tests during maintenance windows." drafting RCA now.
